# Booking.com
> Booking.com is a global online travel platform for discovering and booking accommodations, flights, car rentals, attractions, and airport taxis.

The site serves travelers with search, booking, account management, customer support, and partner-facing tools for property owners, affiliates, and connectivity providers.

## Traveler Help & Support
- [Customer Service Help Center](https://www.booking.com/content/cs.html): Main support hub for bookings, payments, cancellations, and travel assistance.
- [Coronavirus (COVID-19) Support](https://www.booking.com/content/covid19.html): Travel-related policy guidance and support information for pandemic-era disruptions.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.booking.com/content/terms.html): Core legal terms governing use of Booking.com services and bookings.
- [Privacy and Cookie Statement](https://www.booking.com/content/privacy.html): Explains data handling, privacy practices, and cookie usage.
- [Dispute Resolution / Legal Information](https://www.booking.com/content/legal.html): Legal notices, dispute handling, and regulatory information.
- [Security Resource Center](https://www.booking.com/content/security.html): Guidance on account safety, fraud awareness, and secure platform usage.

## Travel Services
- [Stays](https://www.booking.com/): Main accommodation search for hotels, apartments, resorts, and other properties.
- [Flights](https://flights.booking.com/): Flight search and booking experience for domestic and international routes.
- [Car Rentals](https://www.booking.com/cars/index.html): Car rental search across destinations, dates, and vehicle categories.
- [Attractions](https://www.booking.com/attractions/index.html): Book tours, activities, tickets, and local experiences.
- [Airport Taxis](https://www.booking.com/taxi/index.html): Pre-book airport transfers and local taxi transportation.
- [Flight + Hotel](https://www.booking.com/packages/index.html): Combined trip packaging for flights and accommodations.

## Account & Loyalty
- [Sign In](https://account.booking.com/sign-in): User authentication for managing bookings, preferences, and account details.
- [Create Account](https://account.booking.com/register): Registration flow for new traveler accounts on Booking.com.
- [Manage Bookings](https://www.booking.com/content/mybooking.html): Access and manage reservation details, changes, and support options.
- [Genius Loyalty Program](https://www.booking.com/genius.html): Overview of Booking.com’s traveler rewards and discount program.
- [Wallet / Payment Methods](https://www.booking.com/content/payments.html): Information about payment options, charges, and transaction handling.

## Partner Platform
- [List Your Property](https://join.booking.com/): Entry point for accommodation partners joining the Booking.com platform.
- [Partner Help Center](https://partner.booking.com/en-us/help): Operational support for property owners and accommodation partners.
- [Extranet Login](https://admin.booking.com/): Partner login for managing listings, rates, availability, and reservations.
- [Partner Hub](https://partner.booking.com/): Central resource area for partner tools, guidance, and product updates.
- [Partner Community](https://partner.booking.com/en-us/community): Community discussions and shared advice for Booking.com partners.
- [Partner Resource Center](https://partner.booking.com/en-us/resources): Articles, guides, and operational resources for accommodation partners.

## Connectivity & APIs
- [Connectivity Partner Program](https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs): Documentation for systems integrating with Booking.com partner workflows.
- [Connectivity APIs Overview](https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs/index): Entry point for Booking.com connectivity documentation and integration concepts.
- [Reservations API](https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs/reservations-api): Reference for retrieving and managing reservation data programmatically.
- [Rooms API](https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs/rooms-api): API documentation for room, rate, and inventory-related operations.
- [Content API](https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs/content-api): Access property content, facilities, and descriptive metadata through APIs.
- [Connectivity FAQ](https://developers.booking.com/connectivity/docs/faq): Common implementation and onboarding questions for connectivity partners.

## Affiliate Program
- [Booking.com Affiliate Partner Program](https://www.booking.com/affiliate-program/v2/index.html): Overview of affiliate opportunities for promoting Booking.com inventory.
- [Affiliate Help Center](https://www.booking.com/affiliate-program/v2/help_center.html): Support resources for affiliate setup, tools, and troubleshooting.
- [Affiliate Extranet](https://admin.booking.com/affiliate/): Login area for affiliates managing campaigns and performance.
- [Affiliate Partner Solutions](https://www.booking.com/affiliate-program/v2/partner-solutions.html): Integration and monetization options for affiliate partners.
- [Affiliate Terms & Conditions](https://www.booking.com/affiliate-program/v2/terms_and_conditions.html): Legal terms governing participation in the affiliate program.

## Business & Corporate Travel
- [Booking.com for Business](https://business.booking.com/): Corporate travel platform for managing employee trips and company travel policies.
- [Business Help Center](https://business.booking.com/help): Support resources for business travelers and travel administrators.
- [Business Travel Solutions](https://business.booking.com/business-travel): Overview of features for booking and managing work travel.
- [Expense Management Information](https://business.booking.com/expense-management): Information on business travel spend visibility and reporting capabilities.

## Company & Press
- [About Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/content/about.html): Company background, mission, and platform overview.
- [Careers](https://careers.booking.com/): Job listings, teams, and employment information across Booking.com.
- [Press Center](https://news.booking.com/): Official company news, announcements, and media resources.
- [Sustainability](https://www.booking.com/content/sustainability.html): Information on sustainability initiatives and travel-related impact efforts.
- [Investor and Corporate Information](https://www.bookingholdings.com/): Parent company information for Booking Holdings and corporate disclosures.

## Regional & Policy Information
- [Travel Articles and Inspiration](https://www.booking.com/articles/index.html): Editorial travel content, destination ideas, and trip-planning inspiration.
- [Price Match Information](https://www.booking.com/content/price-match.html): Details on Booking.com’s price match policy and eligibility.
- [Cancellation Policy Information](https://www.booking.com/content/flexible-booking.html): Guidance on flexible booking options and cancellation-related topics.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.booking.com/content/accessibility.html): Information about accessibility commitments and user support.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.booking.com/content/privacy.html): Privacy page covering cookie controls and related data preferences.
